verdict.rationale: Name.com is a SaaS registrar that holds customer and account data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documented AI-training opt-out or data-use policy. WHOIS privacy protection is an adjacent privacy control about public registrant data, not about AI training, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
